weakens_tests.reason: POST /baseline-survey no longer computes a TypeScript-only Day-0 score and upserts it into vitana_index_scores (sparring F15, owner decision D4b). The two tests that pinned score_total 125/127 from the TS curve and model_version 'baseline-survey-v3-5pillar' now pin the new contract: the survey is saved, the score comes from vitana_index_recompute_and_record (trigger baseline_survey) and no direct vitana_index_scores write happens; a third test pins the 400 on a failed compute.

The bridge still recomputes the Index exactly once per call (AC-8 unchanged); the RPC it calls is now the locked recording function with trigger wearable_sync, so the asserted RPC name and parameters changed. The count assertion is the same.
The voice log tools recompute through vitana_index_recompute_and_record instead of health_compute_vitana_index_for_user; only the mocked RPC name changed, every assertion is the same.
